message: userAssignedIdentities property in patch body is not present in the corresponding put body. A patch request body must only contain properties present in the corresponding put request body, and must contain at least one of the properties.

tags property in patch body is not present in the corresponding put body. A patch request body must only contain properties present in the corresponding put request body, and must contain at least one of the properties.
Tags should not be specified in the properties bag for proxy resources. Consider using a Tracked resource instead.
